tagline: A needle on a spectrum. One of you hints. The other finds the mark.
description:
One of you is the psychic. They see a mark sitting somewhere between two opposites — hot and cold, friend and enemy, trashy and classy. They give a clue: one thought that belongs on that line, right where the mark is. The other is the guesser. They slide a needle to where they think the clue lives.

The closer the needle, the more you score. Dead on is four, close is three or two, and a miss is nothing. A bullseye also buys the table another card. You have seven cards, and the psychic seat passes after each one. Sit together on one device, or press Play a friend and send the invite: psychic on one side, guesser on the other.

An unofficial port of Longwave by cynicaloptimist. The original needs a game server. This copy does not — send the invite and you are in the same game.
